title: Climate Risks in Financial Markets
venue: Handbook of the Economics of Climate Change

title: Climate risks in US housing and mortgage markets
Credit Rationing in Unsecured Debt Markets
Strategies for Using Markets to Adapt to Climate Change
Bank Competition and Strategic Adaptation to Climate Change
abstract: How does competition affect banks’ adaptation to emergent risks for which there is limited supervisory oversight? The analysis matches detailed supervisory data on home equity lines of credit with high resolution flood projections to identify climate risks. Following Hurricane Harvey, banks updated their internal risk models to better reflect flood risk projections, even in areas unaffected by the disaster. These updates are only detected in banks with exposures to the disaster, indicating heterogeneous bank learning. We use this heterogeneity to identify how bank adaptation is affected by competition. Exposed banks reduce lending to areas with higher flood risks, but only in less competitive markets, suggesting that competition fosters risk-taking over risk mitigation. Additionally, banks are less likely to adapt in markets where competitors are also less likely to do so, suggesting a strategic complementarity in bank adaptation. More broadly, our paper sheds light on the role of competitive forces in how banks manage emerging risks and relevant supervisory challenges.
abstract_zh: 在监管监督有限的情况下，竞争如何影响银行对新兴风险的适应？本分析将详细的监管数据（关于房屋净值信贷额度）与高分辨率洪水预测相匹配，以识别气候风险。飓风哈维过后，银行更新了其内部风险模型，以更好地反映洪水风险预测，即使是在未受灾害影响的地区也是如此。这些更新仅在有灾害暴露的银行中被观察到，表明银行的学习存在异质性。我们利用这种异质性来识别竞争如何影响银行的适应。受暴露的银行会减少对洪水风险较高地区的贷款，但这种情况仅出现在竞争较弱的市场中，这表明竞争更多地促进了风险承担，而非风险缓释。此外，在竞争对手也不太可能进行适应的市场中，银行也较少进行适应，这表明银行的适应行为存在战略互补性。更广泛地说，本文揭示了竞争力量在银行管理新兴风险中的作用，以及相关的监管挑战。

title: Financial Conditions and Capital Investment Choices
Housing Prices Under Rising Seas: A Market-Based Measure of Deep Uncertainty
Limited Liability and Disaster Underinsurance
Climate information on sea level rise risk influences individuals' migration preferences in Vietnam
abstract: An important yet understudied factor in climate adaptation is information: are people informed about future climate-related risks, and does adaptation depend on this knowledge? Focusing on whether communication about projected sea level rise affects the stated likelihood of migration, here we developed a randomized information experiment implemented in a face-to-face survey of >7,000 respondents across Vietnam. We find that providing a text-based information treatment regarding Vietnam’s exposure to projected sea level rise increases respondents’ stated likelihood of migration, including respondents at low-risk. A map information treatment leads to a more targeted effect, only increasing the likelihood of migration among respondents in high-risk areas. Finally, adding doubt to the treatments, by mentioning an official repudiation of the information, does not reduce the treatments’ impact. Our findings are inconsistent with the assumption that people are fully informed about climate risks and highlight the importance of spatially precise information in facilitating climate adaptation. In Vietnam, providing text-based information about exposure to projected sea level rise increases respondents stated likelihood of migration, with maps prompting more targeted responses, according to a large-scale survey experiment.
abstract_zh: 气候适应中一个重要但研究不足的因素是信息：人们是否了解未来与气候相关的风险，以及适应是否取决于这些知识？针对关于预计海平面上升的信息是否会影响人们自述的迁移可能性这一问题，我们设计了一项随机化信息实验，并在越南开展了面对面的入户调查，受访者超过7000人。我们发现，提供关于越南在预计海平面上升中所面临暴露风险的文字信息，会提高受访者自述的迁移可能性，包括低风险地区的受访者。地图形式的信息干预则产生了更具针对性的效果，仅提高了高风险地区受访者的迁移可能性。最后，在干预中加入疑虑——例如提及官方对该信息的否认——并不会削弱干预的效果。我们的发现与人们完全了解气候风险的假设不一致，并强调了空间精确信息在促进气候适应中的重要性。在越南，一项大规模调查实验表明，提供关于预计海平面上升暴露程度的文字信息，会提高受访者自述的迁移可能性，而地图则会引发更具针对性的反应。

title: Leveraging the Disagreement on Climate Change: Theory and Evidence
Severe Weather and the Macroeconomy
abstract: We investigate the impact of severe weather shocks on the US macroeconomy over the past 60 years. Using a nonlinear vector autoregressive model, we find robust evidence of time-varying effects. While negligible at the beginning of the sample, the impact becomes signifi-cant at the end, where an increase in the severe weather index reduces aggregate industrial production and consumption growth rates, and raises aggregate unemployment and inflation rates. The effects are persistent for up to 20 months. Our findings suggest limited adaptation to the increased severity of weather in the United States, at least at the macroeconomic level. (JEL E21, E23, E24, E31, Q54)
abstract_zh: 我们考察了过去60年间恶劣天气冲击对美国宏观经济的影响。利用非线性向量自回归模型，我们发现了稳健的时变效应的证据。虽然在样本初期影响可以忽略不计，但在样本末期影响变得显著：恶劣天气指数的上升会降低总工业生产和消费的增长率，并提高总失业率和通货膨胀率。这些效应可持续长达20个月。我们的发现表明，至少在宏观经济层面，美国对日益加剧的恶劣天气的适应能力有限。（JEL分类号：E21、E23、E24、E31、Q54）

title: Climate Defaults and Financial Adaptation
abstract: We analyze the relationship between climate-related disasters and sovereign debt crises using a model with capital accumulation, sovereign default, and disaster risk. We find that disaster risk and default risk together lead to slow post-disaster recovery and heightened borrowing costs. Calibrating the model to Mexico, we find that the increase in cyclone risk due to climate change leads to a welfare loss equivalent to a permanent 1% consumption drop. However, financial adaptation via catastrophe bonds and disaster insurance can reduce these losses by about 25%.Our study highlights the importance of financial frictions in analyzing climate change impacts.
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个包含资本积累、主权违约和灾害风险的模型，分析了与气候相关的灾害与主权债务危机之间的关系。我们发现，灾害风险与违约风险共同导致灾后恢复缓慢和借贷成本上升。以墨西哥进行校准，我们发现，气候变化导致的气旋风险上升，会造成相当于永久性消费下降1%的福利损失。然而，通过巨灾债券和灾害保险进行的金融适应，可以将这些损失减少约25%。本研究强调了金融摩擦在分析气候变化影响中的重要性。

title: Long-term Effects of Redlining on Environmental Risk Exposure
abstract: We provide new evidence that policies implemented nearly a century ago have significant causal effects on the exposure of 9 urban communities in the U.S. to climate-related risks. Using a boundary design, we show that redlining, a discriminatory federal housing policy pursued in the 1930s and outlawed in the 1960s, has resulted in persistent inequality in climate risk exposure. Locations in neighborhoods assigned lower credit grades have significantly higher exposure to flooding and higher air temperatures than comparable locations with higher grades. We attribute these disparities to lower measures of environmental capital, specifically tree coverage and ground surface perviousness, in these neighborhoods. Our findings underscore the ongoing causal effects of historical housing policies on present-day exposure to climate risks, and highlight the need to address the legacies of past policies in adapting to future climate risks.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了新的证据，表明近一个世纪前实施的政策对美国9个城市社区暴露于气候相关风险的程度具有显著的因果效应。利用边界设计，我们表明，红线划分（redlining）——一项在20世纪30年代实施、20世纪60年代被禁止的歧视性联邦住房政策——导致了气候风险暴露方面的持续不平等。与条件相当但信用评级较高的地点相比，被评定为较低信用等级的社区中的地点，其洪水暴露度和气温显著更高。我们将这些差异归因于这些社区中环境资本——特别是树木覆盖和地表透水性——水平较低。我们的研究结果强调了历史住房政策对当今气候风险暴露的持续因果效应，并凸显了在适应未来气候风险时应对过往政策遗留问题的必要性。

title: Race and Environmental Worries
abstract: We use survey data to document a strong heterogeneity in stated degrees of worry about environmental problems across racial groups. Minorities are significantly more worried about air and water pollution than their white counterparts, even after controlling for socioeconomic factors and pollution exposure. Our finding implies that residential sorting based on heterogeneous financial resources and heterogeneous levels of environmental concern is unlikely to be the only driver of uneven exposure to pollution across racial groups.
abstract_zh: 我们利用调查数据，记录了不同种族群体在自述的环境问题担忧程度上存在的显著差异。即使在控制了社会经济因素和污染暴露之后，少数族裔对空气和水污染的担忧程度仍显著高于白人。我们的发现表明，基于异质性经济资源和异质性环境关注程度的居住分异，不太可能是造成不同种族群体污染暴露不均的唯一原因。

title: The Transmission of Quasi-Sovereign Default Risk: Evidence from Puerto Rico
Bubbly Recessions
Asset Bubbles and Global Imbalances
Regressive Welfare Effects of Housing Bubbles
Temperature and Growth: A Panel Analysis of the United States
venue: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
abstract:
We document that seasonal temperatures have significant and systematic effects on the U.S. economy, both at the aggregate level and across a wide cross section of economic sectors. This effect is particularly strong for the summer: a
F increase in the average summer temperature is associated with a reduction in the annual growth rate of state‐level output of 0.15 to 0.25 percentage points. We combine our estimates with projected increases in seasonal temperatures and find that rising temperatures could reduce U.S. economic growth by up to one‐third over the next century.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，季节性气温对美国经济具有显著且系统性的影响，这种影响既体现在总量层面，也体现在广泛的经济部门中。夏季的影响尤为强烈：夏季平均气温每升高1华氏度（F），州级产出的年增长率就会下降0.15至0.25个百分点。我们将估计结果与对季节性气温升高的预测相结合，发现在未来一个世纪内，气温上升可能使美国经济增长率降低多达三分之一。

A Model of Sovereign Debt with Private Information
venue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control

title: Bubbles, Wage Rigidity, and Persistent Slumps
Nominal Sovereign Debt
Sovereign Debt Signals
Information, Insurance and the Sustainability of Sovereign Debt
abstract: In an influential paper, Bulow and Rogoff (1989) prove that in a competitive financial market, the threat of credit exclusion alone cannot sustain repayment of sovereign debt, as the defaulting government can still enter cash-in-advance insurance contracts. However, their result relies on an important assumption: symmetric information. This short paper shows that if a debtor government has some private information about the underlying distribution of future economic shocks, then debt repayment is sustainable in equilibrium. This is true even if there is only one period with private information, and even if default does not have a spillover effect to any other relationship. The intuition is that a default is a signal of a bad distribution of future shocks, leading to a higher risk premium on future financial contracts.
abstract_zh: 在一篇有影响力的论文中，Bulow和Rogoff（1989）证明，在竞争性金融市场中，仅凭信贷排斥的威胁无法维持主权债务的偿还，因为违约政府仍可以签订预付现金型保险合同。然而，他们的结论依赖于一个重要假设：信息对称。这篇短文表明，如果债务国政府拥有关于未来经济冲击潜在分布的一些私人信息，那么在均衡中债务偿还就是可持续的。即使只有一个时期存在私人信息，并且违约对任何其他关系都不产生溢出效应，结论依然成立。其直观解释是，违约是未来冲击分布不利的信号，从而导致未来金融合同的风险溢价上升。

title: Toxic Asset Bubbles
abstract: We develop a growth model with credit-fueled speculative asset bubbles. In our model, financial intermediaries (banks) use borrowed money to speculate on a risky asset bubble, which promises high returns as long as the bubble does not collapse. However, with limited liability, banks can default on their debt and avoid absorbing all the losses when the bubble collapses. As a consequence, excessively risky (or “toxic”) asset bubbles can emerge despite the fact that all agents are perfectly rational. We then show that three different policies can improve welfare: an intervention that “pricks” an existing bubble, a macroprudential tax against bubble speculation, or a macroprudential banking regulation.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个由信贷驱动投机性资产泡沫的增长模型。在该模型中，金融中介（银行）借入资金投机于一个风险资产泡沫，只要泡沫不破裂，该泡沫就承诺高额回报。然而，在有限责任的条件下，当泡沫破裂时，银行可以违约偿还债务，从而避免承担全部损失。因此，即使所有主体都完全理性，也可能出现过度风险化（或称“有毒”）的资产泡沫。随后我们表明，三类不同的政策可以改善福利：刺破既有泡沫的干预措施、针对泡沫投机的宏观审慎税，或宏观审慎的银行监管。
